description: List the brands in this Espaço and every place each one publishes to (`destinations`): its Instagram accounts (`connected`, `needsReconnect`) and its blogs (`url`, `state`), each with an `id`. A brand's `profile` is the profile list_profiles shows for it. When a brand has more than one Instagram account, create_post needs `instagram` with the id of the one you mean; with more than one blog, create_article needs `blogId`. Without it the call is refused with the choices and nothing is made. It only reads.
name: list_brands
title: List brands
